The '''Mysterious Stranger''' was a [[blood elf]] [[quest giver]] who was located in every starting zone. He was the original starting point for the [[hardcore]] challenge, which can only be begun at level 1. Hardcore characters who reach level 55 may undertake the process for [[Inferno Mode|eternal mortality]] with him through the [[Mysterious Mailbox]], in [[Deadwind Pass]].

An '''Echo of the Mysterious Stranger''' resides in [[Medivh's Chambers]] within the [[Tower of Karazhan]]. Unlike the other echoes that wander the halls, he is not oblivious to the presence of adventurers.

==Quests==
* {{questlong|Neutral|1|Stay Awhile and Listen...}} (Hardcore) {{queststartfinish}}

==Quotes==
;After level 1
Well, well... You've had a change of heart, hm? So all of a sudden, you decide that you have business with me? Well, I do not have business with YOU.

Begone!

;Echo in Karazhan
<The Echo's eyes are following you. Chilling.>
